wire_only_forged_fact_control.finding: Wire oracle accepts the same bytes without inspecting store facts; store provenance is a separate unimplemented runtime obligation.

controls.requires_reset_semantics: Historical recovery_needed_seen; accepted-reset can still have requires_reset=true. It is not a current-state RESET command.

limitations: Two candidate offers and two CREDIT offers; no cutoff theorem, fairness or full aggregate/broker refinement.
Independent split/inclusive mapper code shares message encoding and immutable oracle, authored by one integrator.
Retained candidate queue is bounded to two offers; upstream overflow/loss detection and durable store/transport implementation are absent.
Store facts are modeled inputs; provenance is not authenticated by M1B wire validation.
Prior c87 full models and their RESET seam counterexample remain unchanged historical evidence.
